sections.heading: Multilingual AI dubbing for animation and games.
sections.body: Your content already has a voice. Take it further with professional dubbing, more languages and production built around your project.

items.title: Animation · Take your catalogue further
items.body: For producers, distributors and IP owners. Build versions for new territories, coordinate languages and maintain each character’s vocal identity across series and recurring content.

items.title: Games · More languages for your world
items.body: For developers and publishers. Handle dialogue volumes, NPCs and updates with performed voices, generated voices or a combination, chosen for each character and localization workflow.

sections.heading: Hear the characters. Compare the languages.
sections.body: Hear what we can do. This is what our AI voices sound like.

sections.heading: From script to delivery.
sections.body: The whole production or the stage you need. We agree the materials, voices and deliverables before work begins.

items.title: Casting and voices
items.body: Selection, creation or generation to fit the project.

items.title: Subtitling
items.body: Translation and timing where the project requires it.

sections.heading: Different characters. Different voices.
sections.body: Actors, AI voices or both. We choose the method around your character, content and budget. Creating the voice and producing the dub are separate stages.

items.title: Custom AI voices
items.body: Voice creation for the project’s requirements, with the appropriate permissions.

items.title: Synthetic and catalogue voices
items.body: Designed or selected options with their own usage terms; catalogue voices are non-exclusive.

items.title: Hybrid production
items.body: Combine human performance and generated voices within one production.

sections.note: Voice rights, consent, permitted uses and any exclusivity are agreed per project.

items.title: Adaptation
items.body: Scripts prepared for the language and character.

items.title: Review and delivery
items.body: Linguistic and technical review, then final assets.

sections.heading: Experience you can hear.
sections.body: Audio, localization and games: we know the stages, the teams and what needs to reach delivery. Our demos let you hear the work.
